breakfast.name: Bajan Saltfish and Bakes
ingredients: For bakes: 2 cups flour, baking powder, butter, water, oil for frying
instructions: Boil and flake saltfish
Sauté onion, tomatoes, pepper, thyme, scotch bonnet
Add fish, toss together
Make bakes: mix dough, shape rounds, fry until golden
Serve saltfish with bakes
breakfast.description: Flaked saltfish with vegetables alongside fried bread.

breakfast.name: Breadfruit Cou-Cou
instructions: Boil breadfruit and okra until very soft
Drain, reserving liquid
Mash together, adding cooking liquid to reach smooth consistency
Stir in butter, season
Serve with flying fish or saltfish
breakfast.description: Mashed breadfruit and okra — a Barbadian comfort food.

breakfast.name: Bajan Bakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients, cut in butter
Add liquid to form soft dough
Shape into rounds, fry until puffy and golden
Serve with saltfish, cheese, or jam
breakfast.description: Puffy fried dough — the Bajan version of Caribbean bakes. Eaten at breakfast with saltfish or as a snack.

lunch.name: Cou-Cou and Flying Fish
ingredients: For sauce: tomatoes, onion, garlic, thyme, scotch bonnet, lime juice
instructions: Make cou-cou: boil okra, stir in cornmeal slowly, cook smooth, add butter
Season fish with lime and herbs
Make tomato sauce with onion, garlic, thyme
Steam fish in sauce until cooked
Mold cou-cou, top with fish and sauce
lunch.description: Barbados's national dish — cornmeal with okra and steamed flying fish.

lunch.name: Macaroni Pie
instructions: Cook macaroni until just tender
Mix with most of the cheese, eggs, milk, mustard, ketchup
Pour into baking dish
Top with remaining cheese and butter
Bake at 180°C 40 min until golden
lunch.description: Barbados's beloved baked macaroni and cheese pie.

lunch.name: Pudding and Souse
ingredients: Souse: 2 pig feet, 2 pig ears, 1 pig snout, lime juice, cucumber, onion, parsley, Scotch bonnet, salt
Pudding: grated sweet potato, seasoning (thyme, marjoram, onion, Scotch bonnet), suet or butter, pig intestine casing or foil
instructions: Boil pork pieces until very tender, 1+ hours
Cool in lime juice with sliced cucumber, onion, parsley, hot pepper — this is the souse
For pudding: mix grated sweet potato with seasoning and suet
Stuff into cleaned casings or wrap in foil
Steam 30 min until firm
Slice pudding, serve alongside souse
lunch.description: Saturday afternoon tradition in Barbados — sweet potato pudding stuffed in casing, alongside pickled pork in lime. Sold from roadside vendors across the island.

lunch.name: Macaroni Pie (Bajan Baked Mac)
ingredients: Ketchup (yes, ketchup — this is Bajan tradition)
instructions: Cook macaroni until just al dente
Mix eggs, evaporated milk, mustard, ketchup, hot sauce
Combine with macaroni and most of the cheese
Pour into buttered baking dish
Top with remaining cheese and dots of butter
Bake at 175°C for 35-40 min until golden and firm — it must be sliceable, not scoopable
Cool 10 min before cutting into squares
It's mac and cheese but denser — more like a savory cake
lunch.description: Bajan mac pie — not saucy American mac and cheese, but a dense, sliceable, baked casserole with ketchup in the mix. Went viral when Rihanna talked about it. Every Sunday table in Barbados has a pan.

dinner.name: Pepper Pot (Bajan Style)
instructions: Brown meats in large pot
Add cassareep, cinnamon, cloves, scotch bonnet
Cover with water, simmer 60 min
Add spinach, cook 30 more min
Adjust seasoning
Serve with rice or bread
dinner.description: A deep, dark, spiced meat stew.

dinner.name: Fried Fish with Bajan Seasoning
ingredients: For Bajan seasoning: green onions, thyme, marjoram, parsley, garlic, scotch bonnet, lime juice
instructions: Blend all seasoning ingredients into paste
Score fish, rub with seasoning, marinate 1 hour
Dredge in flour
Fry in hot oil until golden and crispy
Serve with coleslaw and macaroni pie
dinner.description: Crispy fried fish marinated in iconic Bajan green seasoning.

dinner.name: Jug Jug
instructions: Cook pigeon peas and salt beef together until tender
Mash peas slightly — keep some texture
Add guinea corn flour gradually, stirring
Cook until thick, like stiff porridge
Season with thyme, green onion, parsley, butter
Serve alongside baked ham — this is Barbados' Christmas dish
dinner.description: A Scottish-African fusion from enslaved Scots and Africans — pigeon peas and salt meat cooked into thick porridge. Traditional Christmas dish.

snacks.name: Fish Cakes
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, egg to batter
Fold in flaked fish, herbs, onions, pepper
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil
Fry until golden brown
Drain and serve with hot sauce
snacks.description: Crispy saltfish fritters — a Bajan street food staple.

snacks.name: Cutters (Fish or Ham Sandwiches)
ingredients: Fried flying fish or baked ham
instructions: Split salt bread rolls
Fill with fried flying fish or sliced ham
Add mustard, pepper sauce, pickles
Press together
snacks.description: Bajan bar food — small salt bread sandwiches stuffed with fish or ham. The name means 'something that goes with rum.'

desserts.name: Coconut Bread
instructions: Cream butter and sugar, add eggs
Mix in flour, baking powder, spice
Add coconut, milk, vanilla, cherries
Pour into loaf pan
Bake at 170°C 50 min
desserts.description: Sweet coconut-studded bread, a Barbadian bakery favorite.

desserts.name: Conkies
instructions: Mix all ingredients together
Wrap portions in banana leaves, tie with string
Steam 40-45 min
Unwrap and serve warm
desserts.description: Steamed banana-leaf parcels of pumpkin, sweet potato, and coconut — made for Independence Day (November 30th) but eaten year-round.

drinks.name: Mauby (Bark Drink)
instructions: Boil bark with spices 15 min
Strain, add sugar while warm
Cool completely
Serve over ice
drinks.description: A bittersweet bark drink unique to the Caribbean.

drinks.name: Rum Punch Bajan Style
instructions: Combine rum, lime juice, syrup
Add bitters, stir well
Pour over ice
Grate fresh nutmeg on top
drinks.description: Barbadian rum punch — simple and strong.

drinks.name: Falernum
instructions: Muddle lime zest, cloves, ginger together
Add rum, steep 24 hours
Strain, add simple syrup and almond extract
Bottle and refrigerate
Use as mixer in rum cocktails
drinks.description: Bajan-born syrup liqueur — lime, almond, clove, and ginger. An essential ingredient in Caribbean rum cocktails worldwide.
